lines: I'd build a proper trade house
if you plan to keep trading here.
You could carry more kinds of goods
Ships would go out of their way
And who'd run it? The villagers
Ask merchants to invest in it.
Their money will get you started.
The profits will keep it running.
You could make more local goods
You don't fret like you used to.
I guess I can tell you.
She's kind and quick to notice
She never talks down to you.
Why are you so worked up? Oh!
It's the end of the world!
Oh, great. The fool with the bombs.
He's at the workshop outside town,
This is getting weird, isn't it?
Just hear them out! I'm sure
it'll be good for you, too.
I'm not sure I follow, but
does that mean you'll come with us?
They make a fine gift, too.
Give them to a woman at a tavern
and you'll win her over in no time.
Get on her good side and she'll
tell you all kinds of things.
I won't go a coin lower.
Fine! I won't buy from you anyway!
I'm not selling to you. Move along.
